title: Translate PDFs and keep their layout
summary: PDF translation that keeps the layout, whole-folder translation, folder pages, export preview and a context field for memories.

sections.title: PDF translation
sections.note: Translate a PDF in Playground or Cosmos. Only the text changes, the layout stays.

items.body: Indian scripts, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, Cyrillic and Greek render correctly
Original and translation scroll side by side
Text that doesn't fit its box is flagged, never dropped

sections.title: Translate a whole folder
sections.note: Pick a Drive folder and translate every file in it into each language.

items.body: Preview files, word counts and cost before you run
Output lands next to the source, in your i18n layout
Text Translation: several target languages at once
Open a folder to see every process filed in it
**Save to Assets** asks which folder to save in
Translate Video: preview an export before downloading it
Translate Video: choose the lip-sync model per export
Translate Photo: retry a failed translation in place
Translation Memory: a **Context** field tells the AI what a memory is for
PDF translation costs 0.5 credits per source word
